# The Pickleball Doctor

> > Professional pickleball coaching and physical therapy services by Dr. Noe Sariban, IPTPA-certified instructor and Team Ben Johns physical therapist on the PPA Tour.

The site combines elite pickleball instruction (private lessons, camps, video analysis) with sports medicine expertise, offering injury prevention protocols, rehabilitation guidance, and performance training specifically designed for pickleball players of all levels.

## Coaching & Instruction Services

- [Home | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com): Homepage for Ben Johns-endorsed coaching, lessons, camps & staycations
- [Pickleball Instruction | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/services): IPTPA-certified instruction services: private lessons, camps & video analysis
- [Pickleball Camps and Getaways | Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/pickleballexperience): Multi-day camp schedule across US locations with skill-level groups
- [About the Doctor | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/about-the-doctor): Dr. Noe Sariban's bio: Duke PT doctorate, Ben Johns team member, IPTPA pro
- [PPA Tour with Ben Johns | Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/about-3): Physical therapy role traveling with Ben Johns on PPA Tour

## Injury Prevention & Performance

- [Injury Prevention | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/injury-prevention): Complete training framework: mobility, strength, and sport-specific prep
- [Common Pickleball Injuries | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/common-pickleball-injuries): Injury types: falls, strains, sprains, joint dysfunctions & tendinopathies
- [Strength and Conditioning | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/strength-and-conditioning): Building endurance and strength for pickleball performance and longevity
- [Mobility and Flexibility Basics | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/mobility-and-flexibility-basics): Foundation mobility drills and flexibility exercises for injury prevention
- [Sport Specific Training | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/sport-specific-training): Agility drills and plyometric exercises for pickleball performance

## Rehabilitation & Recovery

- [Basic Rehab Recommendations | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/basic-rehab-recommendations): Guide to injury assessment and finding a Physical Therapist for rehab
- [Rehabilitation and Return to Play | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/rehabilitation-and-return-to-play): Recovery protocols and rehab guidelines for common pickleball injuries
- [Misconceptions about Rehab | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/misconceptions-about-rehab): Debunking outdated RICE protocol and icing myths in injury treatment
- [Cool Down | The Pickleball Doctor](https://thepickleballdoctor.com/cool-down): Post-game recovery routines and static stretching for tournament play
